title: Bounded Australian electric road-trike market-audit integration
scope: Six family groups, seven dispositions; one advertised-New-offer audit row, five unresolved entries and one peripheral future candidate. No detailed, ranking, physical-stock or complete-vehicle admission.
evidenceLimits: The accepted 22-source packet contains short source-bound excerpts and retrieval records, not full source bodies. Not every source establishes a current offer. Publication dates, observation dates, seller years and future forecasts remain distinct.

sources.summary: Historical fleet operation is supported by manufacturer testimony. It is not current public new-stock or factory-order evidence.

Dealer catalogue lists CT-KARGO, 50 km/h, LiFePO4 73.6 V / 95 Ah / 6.992 kWh, 3.7 kW, 1,245 L cargo and white colour. Inquiry form only. Current direct HTTP retrieval failed (502); web extraction is cached/indexed, reported crawl around three months ago. Approval is a dealer claim, not independently verified.

Named CT-KARGO KOOL chilled-cargo derivative. Same claimed approval, battery, dimensions, wheelbase and motor as CT-KARGO; 1,000 L box and 150 kg max-load claim. Use one family with a named refrigerated configuration, not an extra unrelated model family. Inquiry-only and direct HTTP 502.

CT-KUBE dealer page lists 50 km/h, 4 kW, LiFePO4 51.2 V / 95 Ah / 4.864 kWh and white colour. Cargo bay descriptions: Honey Comb Panel (1) 500 L; Honey Comb Panel (2) 450 L; EPP 255 L. These are listed body options, not proved currently offered trims. Inquiry-only and direct HTTP 502.

Names all three EMoS cargo products and generic road-use/finance marketing. Footer 2022 and months-old indexing do not prove supplier continuity or new availability in October 2026. Homepage was already used for other unresolved EMoS/WYLD leads in canonical inventory.

Historical report lists CT-KARGO AU$14,999 and CT-KUBE AU$12,999, both coded LA. Dealer pages instead claim LB. Neither historical price nor LA code is adopted as current. Listed figures are industry submissions/desktop research, not current stock proof.

sources.verbatimExcerpt: This information has not been verified or approved by the department.
sources.summary: Current linked RVD generated 12 September 2025 lists Cargo 01 and Cargo 02. Both use 58 Ah LEAD-ACID, 3.90 kW electric engines, one seat, 368 kg tare, 1175 mm width and 2035 mm wheelbase. Engine records are 72 V DC 01 (4050 rpm) and 72 V DC 02 (2000 rpm). No lithium option appears. RVD data is supplied by applicant, with an explicit accuracy disclaimer. Regulatory variants are not demonstrated retail trims; the displayed VIN is a pattern, not a unit.

Fresh direct HTTP 200 advertises Mate150 in New condition, AU$6,386.55, green, seller-entered model year 2025, 72 V, 3900 W, hydraulic tipper, location Indooroopilly QLD. Seller os54073; affiliation with JNN not verified. Source displays purchase controls and a generic connection-error message. No VIN, unit stock quantity or allocation verified. Price differs from supplier MSRP and is not a drive-away quote.

sources.summary: Two image-only pages visually inspected. Base Mate150 AU$6,195, VTA-065474; 42 km/h; 1500 W rated/3900 W max; six 12 V 58 Ah AGM lead-acid batteries; 50-60 km max range; curb 270 kg; battery mass 6 x 15.5 kg; GVM 543 kg. row.evidenceNote: An Australian seller advertises a New Mate150 offer, with order requests advertised. The supplier separately names Mate150 and links it to type approval VTA-065474. Physical stock, seller acceptance, delivery and individual registration remain unverified.
limitations: Type approval is not a VIN-specific RAV record or state registration. No actual VIN supplied or checked.
Cargo 01/02 are approval variants; not proved two saleable retail trims.
Supplier current flyer curb 270 kg and RVD tare 368 kg have different/unclear bases. Do not rank mass or infer payload.
No evidence of guaranteed stock count, delivery date, seller acceptance or completed sale.
eBay seller-year 2025 is offer metadata, not factory model-year certification; seller affiliation is unverified.

The supplier FAQ joins the marketed Mate150 to JINPENG JP1500DZH-B / OZetrike, VTA-065474, observed In Force on 12 October 2026. This is type-level LB approval, not verification of a particular offered build, VIN, RAV entry or state registration.

The published road vehicle descriptor lists 58 Ah lead-acid batteries for Cargo 01 and Cargo 02. Its applicant-supplied specifications are not department-verified; no exact retail grade or numeric ranking is established.
Mate150L is a separately named future lithium preorder whose approval is unverified. The base Mate150 lead-acid approval must not be transferred to Mate150L.

The supplier advertises AU$6,195 before on-road costs; the separate eBay seller advertises AU$6,386.55. ACTIVE, InStock and Buy It Now are advertising metadata, not physical-inventory, seller-acceptance or completed-sale verification.

methodsAndLimits: Public manufacturer/distributor/dealer/regulator browsing only. No contacts, form submissions, credentials, purchases, application changes, deployment, Git or cloud tasks.
